subject: BillFlow staging cutover & invoice delivery — AP handoff
messages:
From: Samantha Price <samantha@acmecorp.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: BillFlow staging cutover & invoice delivery

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the intro last week. We are preparing to move a subset of our invoices into your BillFlow staging environment and wanted to align on the handoff. Two quick asks from AP: 1) how will Redwood deliver e-invoices (portal push vs. email copy) during the staging window; 2) what fields do you need for VAT reconciliation and remit IDs so our AR team can consume them automatically.

We have a small canary of ~25 invoices (mostly recurring SaaS, VAT-enabled) that we'd like to route through the new flow first. Attached is a sample e-invoice xml and our minimal PO/line-item expectations.

Primary AP contact is ap@acmecorp.com (procurement team cc'd). Please include a clear fallback path — we'll need email PDF copies for any failures for 30 days.

Appreciate a short checklist so we can get sign-off from our AP lead.

Thanks,
Samantha Price
Head of Procurement Operations
ACME Corporation
[Attachment: acme-einvoice-sample.xml (application/xml)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 06:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: BillFlow staging cutover & invoice delivery

Hi Samantha — thanks for the sample and context.

Proposed phased cutover (short):
- Phase 0 (validation): we validate XML schema and remit ID mapping against your sample (no production delivery).
- Phase 1 (canary): route the 25 invoices to BillFlow staging. Delivery mode = portal push + simultaneous email copy to ap@acmecorp.com for 30 days.
- Phase 2 (go-live): after canary success, switch to portal-only (if you opt in) with email copies as a configurable fallback for 14 days.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm the remit ID field name in your XML (is it <RemitID> or <RemitAccount>?).
- Are reverse-charge/VAT-override flags present at line level? If yes, please include example lines.
- PO policy: confirm whether accting will reject invoices without a PO for amounts > $5k.

I've attached our cutover checklist (short checklist + rollback steps) and a billing-contact matrix template. For the canary we'll keep a manual watch and produce a token-level latency/cost report each day.

Fallbacks: if portal push fails, we will automatically queue an SFTP transmission (if you provide host details) and, failing that, email a PDF to ap@acmecorp.com.

Next steps: can you confirm AP recipient for email copies and the remit ID tag? Also cc your tax lead if VAT nuances are required.

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-billflow-cutover-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Samantha Price <samantha@acmecorp.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 07:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: BillFlow staging cutover & invoice delivery

Connor — thanks, this looks good. A few responses inline below and an attachment.

- Remit ID: we'll use <RemitAccount> (newer schema). I'll attach a sanitized sample that includes VAT tags and line-level reverse-charge indicators.
- VAT: we have mixed VAT handling; most subscriptions include VAT, but professional services can be reverse-charged. Our tax ops (cc'ed via procurement alias) will flag any exceptions in the sample.
- PO policy: correct — PO required for invoices > $5k. If Redwood can add a PO header validation in Phase 1 that'd reduce noise.

AP recipient for email copies: ap@acmecorp.com (this address is monitored by a distribution alias that includes our AP lead, Janet Li). Please put the invoice subject line prefix: [ACME-INVOICE] so our ingestion filters pick them up.

Attached: sanitized XML (acme-einvoice-sample.xml) and a brief remit mapping doc. We'll sign off on the canary once we see 3 consecutive successful deliveries and the PO validation working.

Samantha Price
Head of Procurement Operations
ACME Corporation
[Attachment: acme-einvoice-sample.xml (application/xml)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kickoff: BillFlow staging cutover & invoice delivery — AP handoff

Team — quick internal notes and actions before we confirm with ACME: 

- RemitAccount is noted; update our XML mapping and validate against Samantha's sample. Marissa, please add a PO header validation rule for >$5k invoices (reject with a clear error).
- Schedule canary window: propose 2027-06-15 08:00-12:00 PT for the first batch push to staging. Connor, please run the daily token-latency and failure report for the 3-day watch period.
- DocuSign: procurement requested a small T&Cs amendment to enable portal push; link below (needs signature from legal).
- Attachments to send to ACME: redwood-billflow-cutover-checklist.xlsx and billing-contact-matrix.pdf. We'll keep email copies for 30 days during canary.

Related jira: RDW-OPS-2147 (canary schedule + validation).

Connor — please reply to Samantha with the proposed canary date and include the DocuSign link for the T&Cs. I'll follow up with Marissa on the PO validation rule today.

Kimberly Park
Manager, Billing Integrations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: billing-contact-matrix.pdf (application/pdf)]
